nodes.label: ADR 0018: Platform Payment Ledger as Audit Mirror
nodes.rationale: Use existing platform_payment_ledger control-panel table as write-only audit mirror, idempotent on stripe_event_id. Event kinds: pi_succeeded, pi_refunded, saas_invoice_paid, application_fee_collected. Key fields: stripe_event_id (UNIQUE dedupe), organization_id (nullable), event_kind, stripe_object_id, stripe_account, amount/application_fee/currency (minor units), occurred_at (Stripe time). INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. Writes from webhook handlers (real-time) and C.1 backfill cron.
alternatives_rejected: Query Stripe live every time (rate-limited, slow, breaks on outage)
Per-tenant rows in tenant DB (cross-tenant aggregation requires fan-out)
Event-sourcing full Stripe payload as JSONB (columnar aggregation wins over blob)
